设计意图： Reducing the drawdown lookback from 252 to 60 days makes the signal more responsive to recent drawdown events, targeting improved RankIC and ICIR while preserving the core drawdown-volatility mechanism. The shorter window captures mean-reversion opportunities more promptly. Removal of EMA smoothing simplifies the factor and reduces lag.

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-DD_60d / (ATR_20d / close)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：neg(DD_60d) → 返回-x
  2. 步骤2：divide(ATR_20d, close) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  3. 步骤3：divide(v1(neg), v2(divide)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 high：high
  2. 计算 low：low
  3. 计算 close：close
  4. 计算 rolling_max：close.rolling(window=60, min_periods=20).max()
  5. 计算 drawdown：(close - rolling_max) / rolling_max
  6. 计算 tr：np.maximum(high - low
  7. 计算 atr：tr.rolling(window=20, min_periods=10).mean()
  8. 计算 normalizer：atr / close
  9. 计算 normalizer：normalizer
  10. 计算 factor：-drawdown / normalizer
  11. 计算 factor：factor

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_recovery_short_window(df): df_copy = df.copy() high = df_copy["str">'high'] low = df_copy["str">'low'] close = df_copy["str">'close'] rolling_max = close.rolling(window=60, min_periods=20).max() drawdown = (close - rolling_max) / rolling_max tr = np.maximum(high - low, np.maximum((high - low.shift(1)).abs(), (low - high.shift(1)).abs())) atr = tr.rolling(window=20, min_periods=10).mean() normalizer = atr / close normalizer = normalizer.replace(0, np.nan) factor = -drawdown / normalizer factor = factor.fillna(0) factor.name = "str">'factor_drawdown_recovery_short_window' "kw">class="kw">return factor
